# ISO 1200 Magazine

> > ISO 1200 Magazine is a photography blog providing tutorials, gear reviews, and techniques for portrait, wedding, and landscape photography.

The site features expert tutorials on studio lighting, post-processing in Lightroom and Photoshop, and camera reviews from brands like Sony, Fujifilm, and more. Content includes practical guides from industry professionals like Lindsay Adler, Gavin Hoey, and Sean Tucker, covering everything from speedlight setups to film photography.

## Key Topics

- Portrait Photography
- Studio Lighting Techniques
- Adobe Lightroom
- Camera Reviews
- Wedding & Engagement Photography
- Post-Processing & Color Correction
- Speedlight & Flash Photography
- Mirrorless Cameras
- Film Photography
- Beauty Dish & Clamshell Lighting
- Landscape & Macro Photography
- Product Photography
- Two-Light Setups
- Photography Composition

## Portrait & Studio Lighting

- [How to Master Beauty Dish Portrait Lighting (Step-by-Step Guide)](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/12/how-to-master-beauty-dish-portrait.html): Joel Grimes' step-by-step beauty dish lighting guide for Westcott
- [Painterly Portraits with Two Speedlights](https://www.iso1200.com/2024/11/painterly-portraits-with-two-speedlights.html): Sean Tucker's Rembrandt-style portrait tutorial using two speedlights
- [Create Professional Headshots ONLY Using Umbrellas with Lindsay Adler](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/03/create-professional-headshots-only.html): Lindsay Adler's umbrella-only headshot lighting tutorial for Adorama
- [3 LIGHTING SETUPS for B&W Editorial Portraits](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/08/3-lighting-setups-for-b-editorial.html): Three lighting setups for black & white editorial portraits with AD600 Pro
- [Clamshell Using LED Panels via Peter Coulson](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/11/clamshell-using-led-panels-via-peter.html): Peter Coulson demonstrates clamshell lighting setup using LED panels
- [Turn Your Studio into a Film Noir Movie Set with Gavin Hoey](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/10/turn-your-studio-into-film-noir-movie.html): Gavin Hoey's film noir studio lighting tutorial for Adorama

## Post-Processing & Editing

- [3 Pro Hacks for Perfect Color Correction and White Balance in Photoshop](https://www.iso1200.com/2026/02/3-pro-hacks-for-perfect-color.html): Photoshop color correction & white balance tutorial by PiXimperfect
- [Lightroom: New Variance Tool easily fixes colors in seconds!](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/11/lightrooms-new-variance-tool-easily.html): Adobe Lightroom's new Variance Tool for sky & color correction tutorial
- [2 Easy Steps for PERFECT Autumn Edits using Lightroom Trick!](https://www.iso1200.com/2024/11/2-easy-steps-for-perfect-autumn-edits.html): Mark McGee's 2-step Lightroom workflow for autumn landscape editing
- [The Clarity Trap: Why You're Ruining Your Waterfall Photos](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/11/the-clarity-trap-why-youre-ruining-your.html): Mark Denney explains clarity slider mistakes in waterfall photography

## Camera Reviews & Gear

- [Fujifilm XT30 III - The Entry Level Camera That is Not So Entry Level!](https://www.iso1200.com/2025/10/fujifilm-xt30-iii-entry-level-camera.html): Fujifilm XT30 III review: entry-level APS-C with X-Processor 5
- [Fujifilm XE5: What happens when a camera finally understands you?](https://www.iso1200.com/2026/01/fujifilm-xe5-what-happens-when-camera.html): GxAce reviews Fujifilm XE5's tactile design and film simulation workflow
- [Why Megapixels Don't Matter (and What You Should Focus On Instead)](https://www.iso1200.com/2024/10/megapixels-dont-matter-here-is-why.html): Debunking megapixel myths and what actually matters for image quality
